info.name: Tripfy API
info.description: Generated from the registered Express routes and their current controllers, middleware, validators, and Mongoose models. Covers all 33 registered HTTP method/path combinations under /api/v1. Import with the Tripfy Local environment. See postman/README.md for order, setup, side effects, external dependencies, and known backend contract issues.

item.name: Health
item.description: Public service and database connectivity check.

exec: pm.test("Status reflects DB health", function () { pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test("Health payload shape", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("status"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("db"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("timestamp"); });

request.description: Public. Returns 200 when MongoDB is connected or 503 when disconnected. Both states are valid health-contract responses.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Cookie-based signed JWT/refresh sessions with Bearer access-token fallback. Postman stores Set-Cookie values in its cookie jar. Mutation requests also send the optional CSRF header.

request.description: Public. Always issues a csrfToken cookie and JSON token. Run before mutations when CSRF_ENABLED=true.

exec: pm.test("Signup response contract", function () { pm.expect(j.msg).to.eql("User registered successfully"); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("user"); pm.expect(j.accessToken).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Public. Creates a role=user account, returns 201 and accessToken, and sets signed access/refresh cookies. Name is 3-50 characters; email valid/unique; password at least 6 characters; role is forbidden. Creates database data.

exec: pm.test("Login response contract", function () { pm.expect(j.msg).to.eql("Login successful"); pm.expect(j.user).to.have.all.keys("name", "email", "role"); pm.expect(j.accessToken).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Public. Validates email/password, returns accessToken and user, stores hashed refresh token, and sets signed cookies. Rate limited to 15 attempts per 15 minutes.

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Public login endpoint using administrator credentials supplied locally. Captures adminAccessToken. No admin credentials are included in the environment.
Authenticated user. Accepts signed token cookie or Bearer JWT. Returns claims from the access token.

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Requires the signed refreshToken cookie from signup/login; Bearer tokens are not used by this handler. Rotates the refresh token and sets new access/refresh cookies. Rate limited.

exec: pm.test("Logout acknowledged", function () { pm.expect(j.msg).to.eql("Logged out successfully"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Requires a valid signed refreshToken cookie. Clears the stored refresh token and expires both cookies. This does not revoke an already-captured Bearer JWT.

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Negative case for the registered login endpoint: missing required fields must return the centralized 400 error shape.

item.name: Places
item.description: Public discovery and admin-only place mutations. Query parameters shown are read by the current list controller.

exec: pm.test("Paginated places shape", function () { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.places).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j).to.include.all.keys("count", "total", "page", "totalPages"); });

request.description: Public. Supports category, subcategory, location (city alias), city, search, minRating, maxRating, sort (comma-separated Mongoose sort fields), page, limit, and fields (comma-separated projection). The controller reads `tags` but does not apply it, so tags is intentionally not advertised. Captures the first returned place ID when available.

exec: pm.test("Filtered list contract", function () { pm.expect(j.places).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.page).to.be.a("number"); });

request.description: Public example exercising all active filtering/projection branches. `city` is omitted because it takes precedence over the `location` alias when both are supplied.
Public. Requires a MongoDB ObjectId-like place ID. Returns { place, success:true }; malformed IDs are caught locally and currently return 500 rather than the centralized CastError 404.

exec: pm.test("Place created", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Place added successfully"); pm.expect(j.place._id).to.be.a("string"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only. Required: name, category, location.city, numeric location.coordinates.lat/lng. Optional: subcategory, description, images (HTTP(S) URLs). Creates database data and captures createdPlaceId.

exec: pm.test("Place updated", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Place updated successfully"); pm.expect(j.place.name).to.eql("Postman Test Landmark Updated"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only. Partial update. Validator explicitly checks optional non-empty name/category; Mongoose validates any supplied schema fields. Has database side effects.

exec: pm.test("Image URL returned", function () { pm.expect(j.msg).to.eql("Image uploaded successfully"); pm.expect(j.url).to.match(/^https?:\/\//); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only. Manual: choose an image file for form-data field `image`. Multer accepts image/* up to 5 MiB in memory. Requires IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY, IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY, IMAGEKIT_URL_ENDPOINT and outbound ImageKit access.

formdata.description: Manually select an image/* file no larger than 5 MiB.

exec: pm.test("Place deleted", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Place deleted successfully"); pm.expect(j.place._id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("createdPlaceId")); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only and destructive. Deletes the selected place. Run after any requests that use createdPlaceId. The controller does not cascade related reviews/plans.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Public listing plus authenticated create/update/delete operations. Update/delete ownership is enforced; admins may delete but may not update another user's review.

exec: pm.test("Paginated reviews shape", function () { pm.expect(j.reviews).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j).to.include.all.keys("count", "total", "page", "totalPages"); });

request.description: Public. `sort` accepts `latest` or `rating`; other values fall back to latest. Paginates reviews for the path placeId.

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated user. Required body: placeId, integer rating 1-5, non-empty comment. Creates database data and captures reviewId. A valid existing placeId is required by Mongoose casting, though existence is not explicitly checked.

exec: pm.test("Review updated", function () { pm.expect(j.review._id).to.eql(pm.environment.get("reviewId")); pm.expect(j.review.rating).to.eql(4); pm.expect(j.review.text).to.eql("Updated review text from Postman."); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated owner only. Despite validator fields being optional, the controller requires both rating and either comment or text. Uses PUT and replaces only text/rating.

exec: pm.test("Review deleted", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Review deleted successfully"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated owner or admin. Destructive. Deletes the review captured by Create Review.

item.name: Plans
item.description: Authenticated, owner-scoped plan CRUD plus one public route for published plans.

exec: pm.test("Plan created", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Plan added successfully"); pm.expect(j.plan._id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.plan.status).to.eql("draft"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated user. Required: planTitle, city, startDate, positive integer duration. Optional planType enum, days, budget, status, note. Creates an owner-scoped plan and captures planId.

body.raw:
{
  "planTitle": "Postman Baghdad Weekend",
  "city": "Baghdad",
  "startDate": "{{planStartDate}}",
  "duration": 2,
  "planType": "leisure",
  "budget": {
    "amount": 250,
    "currency": "USD"
  },
  "status": "draft",
  "note": "Disposable plan created by Postman.",
  "days": []
}

exec: pm.test("Paginated plans shape", function () { pm.expect(j.plans).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j).to.include.all.keys("count", "total", "page", "totalPages"); });

request.description: Authenticated user. Returns only plans owned by the JWT user, newest first.
Authenticated owner only. Populates days.places.place. Non-owner access is indistinguishable from not found (404).

exec: pm.test("Plan published", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Plan updated successfully"); pm.expect(j.plan.status).to.eql("published"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated owner. Partial update. This example publishes an empty-days draft; current pre-save logic permits published plans with zero days, but if days is non-empty its length must equal duration.
Public. Returns only a plan whose status is published. Run after Publish Plan.

exec: pm.test("Plan deleted", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Plan deleted successfully"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated owner only and destructive. Run last in the plan workflow.

item.name: Administration
item.description: Every route is protected by auth plus role('admin'). Supply local administrator credentials and run Login Admin first.

exec: pm.test("Admin users shape", function () { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.users).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(j.users.length); });

request.description: Admin only. Returns all users while excluding password and current refreshToken. previousRefreshToken is not explicitly excluded by the controller.

exec: pm.test("Managed user created", function () { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.user._id).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("user"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only. Required: name, email, password; role is passed directly to the schema and must be user or admin when supplied. Creates database data and captures managedUserId.

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only. Body role must be exactly user or admin. This example promotes the disposable managed user.

exec: pm.test("Managed user deleted", function () { pm.expect(j.msg).to.eql("User deleted successfully"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only and destructive. Self-deletion is rejected with 400. Run after Create/Update Managed User.

exec: pm.test("Admin places shape", function () { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.places).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(j.places.length); });

request.description: Admin only. Returns all places without pagination.

exec: pm.test("Admin route deleted place", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Place deleted successfully"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only and destructive. Set adminDeletePlaceId explicitly to a disposable place. This is distinct from DELETE /place/:id and uses the same controller. It does not cascade reviews/plans.

exec: pm.test("Admin reviews shape", function () { pm.expect(j.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.reviews).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.count).to.eql(j.reviews.length); });

request.description: Admin only. Returns all reviews with populated user name/email and place name.

exec: pm.test("Admin route deleted review", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql("Review deleted successfully"); });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Admin only and destructive. Registered path is /admin/reviews/:id, but the reused controller reads req.params.reviewId. With current code this request is expected to fail its 200 assertion instead of deleting the selected review. Set adminDeleteReviewId only to disposable data for manual verification.

exec: pm.test("Role middleware rejected user", function () { pm.expect(j.msg).to.include("not authorized"); });

request.description: Negative authorization case using a regular user's token. Must return 403.

item.name: AI Planner
item.description: Authenticated AI-backed planning. Requires at least one configured provider and outbound network access.

exec: pm.test("AI plan or conversation shape", function () { if (j.type === "plan") { pm.expect(j.days).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.city).to.be.a("string"); } else { pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); } });

header.description: Required only when server CSRF_ENABLED=true; obtain it with GET /auth/csrf-token.

request.description: Authenticated and rate limited to 30 requests per 15 minutes. Body requires prompt; history defaults to []; currentPlan defaults to null. The server tries Gemini primary, Gemini fallback, Groq, then DeepSeek. Requires at least one corresponding API key and external network access. It reads all places and asks the provider to return JSON.

item.name: Weather
item.description: Public 7-day forecasts backed by Open-Meteo and cached in memory for 10 minutes per place.

exec: pm.test("Forecast item shape", function () { const d = j.forecast[0]; pm.expect(d).to.include.all.keys("date", "maxTemp", "minTemp", "precipitationProbability", "weatherCode", "emoji", "label"); });

request.description: Public. Looks up place coordinates, calls Open-Meteo, transforms a 7-day forecast, and caches it for 10 minutes. Requires a valid place and outbound access to api.open-meteo.com.
